categoryReasons.schemaAndBindings: The quotes load query is read from data.quotes.data and the required asset IDs and USD conversion are fixed in the request.
categoryReasons.apiAndRequestDesign: The request matches the verified keyless CoinMarketCap endpoint, uses a load trigger and cache, and exposes a supported refresh control.
categoryReasons.runtimeCompatibility: The template uses the documented data and status paths, RefreshButton, safe number formatting, and the UTC timestamp helper.
categoryReasons.goalFulfillment: All three assets display price, signed 24-hour change, market cap, volume, and a refresh context with source update time.
categoryReasons.visualQuality: Readable asset/value hierarchy and compact currency metrics help scanning, but the repeated unframed rows and generic text-only treatment fall short of a premium watchlist.
categoryReasons.responsiveAndTheme: Asset names truncate, but the market-cap and volume groups use full labels and are nested in nowrap rows without truncation or a narrow-tile alternative.
categoryReasons.loadingEmptyErrorSuccess: Three loading skeletons, an error alert, an empty-result message, and populated rows cover the main request states.
categoryReasons.dailyUsefulness: The refresh and timestamp support routine checks, but the full-width metric labels are likely to compete for horizontal space in the specifically requested narrow tile.
categoryReasons.complexityDiscipline: A single query and straightforward mapping avoid unnecessary controls, though the repeated stat markup is still plain and offers little extra hierarchy.
categoryReasons.accessibility: Names, metrics, and signed percentages are visible text, and the badge does not rely on color alone, although no explicit refresh label is supplied.
categoryReasons.actionSafety: The widget performs only a read-only load request with no mutation or other unsafe action.

strengths: The exact-asset API request and response paths are correct.
All requested market metrics are present with explicit state handling.
Currency and percentage values use locale formatting and visible signed values.
problems: Full market-cap and volume labels are placed in nested nowrap groups without truncation or a responsive fallback.
The repeated unframed list rows look generic rather than premium.
The refresh helper has no explicit visible label in the JSX.
fatalProblems: The required excellent narrow-tile behavior is missing: full metric labels and values are forced into nested nowrap groups with no truncation or alternative layout.
highestImpactFixes: Adapt or abbreviate the metric row at narrow widths so market-cap and volume remain readable without horizontal crowding.
Give the three repeated quote rows a more deliberate visual hierarchy while retaining the compact footprint.
Add a visible refresh label if the tile width permits.
